examples.english: Having the courage to face adversity helps a person grow.

notes:
A somewhat literary word for serious suffering or difficult circumstances. Composed of {苦|く} (suffering) and ⟦{難|なん}→難：00452_nan⟧ (difficulty). Carries a weightier tone than casual words for difficulty, often used to describe prolonged or significant challenges that test character.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {苦難|くなん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}える→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧: overcome hardship
- {苦難|くなん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{向|む}かう→立ち向かう：06981_tachimukau⟧: face adversity
- {苦難|くなん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧: a path of hardship
- {苦難|くなん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧: endure hardship

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧: difficulty — more neutral, used for problems and obstacles in general
- ⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧: hardship, trouble — more everyday, often includes personal effort
- ⟦{試練|しれん}→試練：14173_shiren⟧: trial, ordeal — emphasizes the testing or challenging aspect
